rationale: No supported optimization is safely applicable. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (dependency caching) is already present in the build, lint, and unit jobs (npm cache keyed on package-lock.json), matching the pattern contraindication that an equivalent cache already exists. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is not needed because every matrix job (integration, integration-versions, integration-matchers, integration-wrapper) already uses the GitHub Actions default fail-fast: true, so adding it explicitly would be a no-op. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT cannot be applied because its precondition requires representative successful-duration history, but the repository CI history is explicitly labeled not_a_measured_baseline/historical_context_only with whole-run timestamps and no per-job durations; imposing a timeout risks false timeouts on valid slow runs such as the Windows integration matrix, matching the contraindication that valid slow runs may exceed the limit. Build and test coverage is preserved unchanged.
